system.description: When you take Arcane, Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Holy or Dark damage or any of its subtypes, you charge your crystals. Your next Crystal Stomp does additional damage equal to the Power of the attacker and the damage type of it changes to the type you took. Does not stack.
You may shift up to 2 stat points (except Toughness). The minimum is 3 and maximum is 9.
Fires a barrage of missiles, making a light attack with arcane damage against all targets in line of sight.  Has a bonus +10 to accuracy.

Mark a target at the end of this creature's turn if there is no mark.  Activates again at the start of the creature's turn.  Fires a barrage of light attacks equal to the amount of party members at the marked target equal to the amount of party members and then mark another target.  Has a +10 to accuracy.  If the target is no longer a valid target, trigger the effects of Alchemic Barrage (Backpack) instead, and then mark another target.
system.requirement: Can only be used when less than half health or if one body party is destroyed.

system.description: This creature gaines +2 extra AP at the start of every turn after its been reduced to less than 50% HP.

Creates an area filled with explosive gas, contained by the wall of Transmute Low Wall (Body).

If an area of gas already exists from a previous turn, ignite the gas into a fireball dealing heavy attack fire damage in the entire area that the gas was in.  Sure Hit.

Upon being critically injured, you draw upon the ancestral strength of past leaders to empower and restore yourself.

Restores Half of your currently missing HP and grants you 2 additional AP on your next turn.

You grant the target ally Angel’s Embrace granting a shield against the triggering attack that blocks damage equal to 2 + (2 x Toughness)

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

When a creature you summoned is within 5ft of you, you may change the target of any attack targeting you to that creature instead. Only works if the creature isn’t already targeted as part of the attack.
When taking the Block action while you have at least 1 mana, your Guard is increased by an additional 8.

Your attacks may deal Physical or Arcane damage. When you deal Arcane damage, the target loses 1 MP though they get to make a Save if this was a light attack. Furthermore, any target ending its turn while rooted by your Consume loses 1 MP.

Your bite channels internal magic. You make a Light Attack that deals Arcane damage. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. If the target is already Dazed, this attack instead deals an additional 8 full pierce Arcane damage as the lingering magic intensifies.

You place a 20x20ft net of arcane energy at a point within range. The net is considered difficult terrain for your enemies. You may spend 0 RP to cancel the net, immediately rooting all creatures within the net’s area of effect at that time until the start of your next turn.
You take half damage from Arcane attacks or damage.
When using the Block reaction, gain +5 guard (Added into the stats already).

You make X separate Light attacks that deal Astra damage against the target. If your Absorb Magic trait is active, you gain the Power bonus for each of these attacks and the element changes to that of the magic absorbed.
You can perfectly detect any creature within 120ft with a spirit core higher than 100.
You make a Heavy attack against the target.

You swipe at the nearest enemy and toss them 30ft away in a direction of your choice. The target passes through allies for this movement, but will collide with walls. If they hit a wall, they take 1d4 true damage and are dazed until the start of your next turn.
system.requirement: Can only be used while your HP is at 25% or lower.

system.description: All Grunt level allies under your command  will fight more intelligently, being more likely to target enemies that are weak or out of position
Upon being reduced to half HP, you go into a tantrum like rage. While in this state, increase your Power by 2. If you are Stunned or Weakened this state will end for the rest of combat.
The target may immediately spend their AP as if they had taken their turn.

You may move up to twice your movement in a straight line towards a target further than 20ft away and gain Trample after moving at least 20ft. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against them. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

When you reach the target you make a Heavy attack against them. On damage, you may select a different target further than 20ft away, moving towards them and repeating this attack at no additional cost. You may only do this once.

You are riding on a mount. The mount has a separate 75 HP, uses your defensive stats and follows normal horse mount rules. While mounted, you can only move in a straight line while taking a movement action. After losing your mount, your movement speed is reduced to 20ft. While above 0 HP, your mount heals for your Toughness HP at the start of your turn.
You teleport to an empty space within range. The next basic Heavy attack you make has it AP cost reduced to 0.

You create a blizzard in a 160ft radius centered on top of you. Any creature in the blizzard that is not immune to frost damage becomes slowed and has their vision reduced to 15ft.

 

Having a suitable heat source nearby or otherwise being protected from the cold removes the slowed effect given by this ability.
You Sidestep up to double your speed. Afterwards, you may stealth for 0 AP. Cannot be used in the same turn as Snow Assassin.
You take double damage from Bludgeoning weapons.

You move up to 4 times your movement speed in a straight line and make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack deals maximum heavy damage if it hits. If it misses, the target moves out of the way and you keep charging until you’ve reached your max movement or until you hit a target or object. All of your movement with this ability does not provoke attacks of opportunity. 

Requires at least 10ft of unimposed movement to start.
When under the Trample effect, you can trample enemies the same size as you (Medium). You also deal an additional Power damage with the attack.
You gain a +1 bonus to your guard and +2 bonus to Block (already added to stats).

You are riding on a boar mount. The boar mount has a separate 10 HP and follows normal boar mount rules. While mounted, you can only move in a straight line while taking a movement action. After losing your mount, your movement speed is reduced to 20ft.

You may move up to three times your movement in a straight line and gain Trample for this movement. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against the,. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

Cannot be used when an enemy unit is visible within 10 feet of you.

You fire a spike from your mouth, making a Precise attack against the target. On damage, the target is pulled next to you in the most direct line possible. If the space next to you is blocked by another creature, the target is placed as closest to the original square as possible.

You begin to quickly roll towards a target with little control.  You move in a straight line towards the target, immediately stopping at the first target or large object in your path and making a Heavy attack against that target.
You move underground at your normal speed. You do not provoke attacks of opportunities except from other burrowed creatures.
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you burrow yourself inside of the target. While burrowed, you shares the same space as the creature you burrowed in and move with it.
If you didn’t move since the start of your last turn, you gain a +1d4 bonus to all accuracy checks.

You are hidden with a Stealth of 30 while pretending to be an ordinary plant until you attack. Luring Pollen does not break camouflage and will not trigger combat when used while creatures are unaware of you.

You may spend 2 or 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement. After you finish moving, you may spend half of the AP you used on this ability on light or heavy melee attacks.

You mark an enemy within range. On the start of your next turn, you may Sidestep towards them in a direct line if possible. If you do, you may immediately make 2 light attacks against the target upon arriving.
system.requirement: Can only be used after Vital Flurry has been used and has been canceled.

system.description: You make a Heavy attack against two different targets in range.
Your Healing spells do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
Combine with a compatible target slime, adding HP and MP together. This can't go over the maximum, but if this results in a slime with maximum health, it restores 1 RP too.
system.requirement: Target must also have the Combine ability.

system.description: You make a light attack against the target. On hit, the target becomes rooted until they spend 1 AP, which removes all slimes that used this action. If the target took damage from this, the AP cost is increased to 2.
If you make an attack of opportunity, you can make a Heavy attack for 0 RP instead of 1. You gain a +2 bonus to accuracy checks when making attacks of opportunity.
Critical attacks deal 125 bonus true damage to you.
You Block or Dodge an attack. Then, you automatically Dodge or Block (whichever you didn't before) against the next attack.

You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes rooted until it takes at least 10 damage in one attack. Medium and smaller creatures are forced to move with the crab, but large creatures grabbed by this prevent you from moving more than 5ft away.

Cannot be used against a target already grabbed.

You may let go of a target for 0 AP. You suffer the root penalty for dodging against the target (but only against the target).
You take half damage from all fire damage and your attacks deal fire damage.
When making a basic Light or Heavy attack with your maw, you become enhanced against Slowed targets. If it’s a Light attack, you gain Sure Hit. If it’s a Heavy attack, you gain Full Pierce.

You make a Light attack against all enemies within range. 

Against an enemy that's overburdened, this also gains Full Pierce.
You reduce the damage you take by 5 until the start of your next turn..
system.requirement: May not have used Crystal Stomp your last turn.

system.description: You make a Light attack that deals Astra damage to all enemies in range. You also take that amount of true damage and your max HP is lowered by that amount. If this reduces your mana to 0, you explode and deal an additional Sure Hit & Full Pierce heavy damage to all enemies in range, after which you die. When you die in this way, you do not drop a fiend core.
system.requirement: Your absorb magic did not trigger since the end of your last turn.

system.description: You stomp the ground and create a shockwave, making a Light attack against all enemies in range.
You heal the target for 9 + Power x 3 HP. You may use either AP or RP for this ability.
You heal the target for 11 + (2 x Power)

You conjure an area of pure darkness in a 30x30 ft area around it, centered on yourself. In the darkness, non-magical light ceases to function.

 

The darkness lasts until your next turn.

If you are in a dark area, you attempt to Hide without using AP. When hiding in darkness, you may stay hidden if you are in direct Line of Sight of others. Leaving the dark area or having any source of light illuminate the area will immediately reveal you.
You make a Heavy attack against the target. Afterwards, you may sidestep up to twice your speed towards the target of the attack.
system.requirement: Can be used when you would make an attack of opportunity.

system.description: A non-heroic creature reduced to 0 HP by you immediately rises as a Wight after 24 hours have passed.

You folds yourself, entering a defensive stance. While in this stance, you can use the Block reaction for 0 RP. You cannot willingly end the stance and cannot make reaction attacks while on it.

 

The stance lasts until the end of the current creature’s turn.
You teleport up to 20ft.
system.requirement: Can only be used after successfully dodging an attack.

system.description: When you reach 0 HP, you will begin to explode. This explosion happens at the start of the turn of the character who triggered this effect. When it does, the Efreet may make a Heavy attack against all creatures within range.
You make a Light attack against the target.
You eat a nearby corpse, instantly devouring it and removing it from the field. You gain +2 AP and your maximum AP is increased by 2 until the end of the encounter.
You deal maximum Light damage to the target. If you used this ability on your previous turn, it deals double the damage it dealt last time.
You attempt to digest all targets affected by Gluttony. Dealing 20 (type) damage with sure hit and full pierce.

Your eyes flash into an aura sight temporarily and make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack deals double Heavy damage, but the damage is reduced to 1 i the target blocks.

If the target does not react to this attack, it gains Sure Hit.
You make a ranged weapon Heavy attack against an enemy in range that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Afterwards, you may sidestep up to your speed.

You move up to 40ft towards a target within range and then make a Light attack against it. On damage, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for the rest of your turn and may move up to your movement speed at the end of your turn without spending AP.

 

If this attack fails to do damage,you lose your Flight ability and become Grounded until the start of its next turn.
You automatically use the Block action against the next attack targeting you.
You make a Heavy attack that deals Holy damage against the target. Against Demons in their Divine Release state, this attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage instead of rolling.
You take two turns. Regardless of initiative, your first turn always comes first in a round. Your second turn comes after half of your enemies have taken their turn.
When you inflict Burning on a target that is already suffering from Burning, they immediately take Fire damage equal to the existing Burning value.

You touch the target and attempt to steal its strength, making a Light attack against the target. On damage, you gain a bonus to your Power for your next attack this turn equal to the target's Power. The target's Power becomes 0 until after its next attack.
You kill the target and regain all your HP.
system.requirement: Target must be trapped by Nightmare Cage

system.description:
You change your own form or the dreamscape to something that frightens or surprises the targets. All creatures within range must make a Save or become Shaken.

What a creature targeted by this sees is unique to each creature.
Drop a creature rooted by your vine grab in your pitcher. The creature becomes stunned and takes Heavy full piercing damage at the start of its turn until you die.
system.requirement: Can only be used as the first action in a turn, must have a grabbed creature.

system.description: Your attacks may deal Earth or Physical damage. When you deal Earth damage, the target must make a Save or becomes Slowed until the end of their next turn.
You take no damage from Earth damage.

You take half damage from Earth and Lightning attacks or damage, but you take 50% more from Wind type attacks and damage. You also take half damage from physical attacks, but your movement speed is halved.
You gain a +1 bonus to saves.
You empower a chosen animal, granting them +2 maximum AP and AP recovery until the end of the encounter.
You discard your armor and shield and focus on offense. You reduce your Guard and Block to 0, but gain an additional 2 AP per turn.
You move 5ft in any direction and do not trigger any Attacks of Opportunity from this movement.
You may Sidestep 5ft.
You may use Evasive Maneuver for 0 RP instead of its normal cost.

You raise the astra level in the zone by 1. All enemies within range that do not have enough resistance to negate this immediately suffer negative effects.

Any creatures suffering from Astra Poisoning immediately have their Astra Poisoning worsened by 1 stage.
You make a Precise attack that deals fire damage against all creatures within range. This attack deals Heavy damage instead of its normal damage.
You teleport in a brief glow of eerie light to any unoccupied spot within 40 ft. Your next Heavy attack this turn costs 0 AP.

Your form appears half-real in dim or moonlit settings. You begin an encounter hidden unless spotted with a Perception check (e.g., DC 23). If forced into bright light, or if you makes noise (like a howl), the GM can allow another Perception roll to detect it.

You prepare to eat a rooted target. When the setup finishes, you make a Heavy attack that deals maximum damage. On damage, you eat the target. The target becomes Stunned inside you. At the start of each of its turns, it takes Heavy full pierce damage until you die.

 

Any attacks made from inside you gains Sure Hit, Full Pierce and deals double damage.
At the end of your turn, you deal a base 1 true damage + 1 true damage to all enemies for each part of your token that is touching the target.

Your attacks may deal Fire or Physical damage. When you deal Fire damage, you also inflict Burning 2*X where X is your Power. Furthermore, any target ending its turn while rooted by your Consume takes light Fire damage.
You take no damage from Fire damage.
You take only half damage from all fire damage.
You take half damage from Fire and Frost attacks or damage, but you take 50% more from Water type attacks and damage. You are immune to Burning.
Fire damage dealt to you is treated as Full Pierce damage.
You take double damage from Fire damage.
You make a Light attack against every creature in a 15x15 ft square. On damage, a target becomes Burning X, where X is your Power x 3.
You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Burning X, where X is your Power x 3.
You breathe fire in a 30ft cone, making a Light attack against all creatures in it. On damage, a target becomes Burning X, where X is your Power x 3.

You can Fly through the air as if you were moving on land and your movement speed is doubled while doing so.

If you take damage while flying higher than 5ft above the ground, your altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce your altitude to the point where you touch the ground, you become rooted and cannot fly again until the end of your next turn. If the attack that reduced your HP came from an flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude.

You can fly through the air as if you were moving on land and your movement speed is doubled while doing so. While flying, you may make any of your attacks (spending AP as normal) during your movement and continue to move afterwards.

You mark an enemy as the target until the start of your next turn. All Grunt level allies under your command must attack that target if they are able to do so without moving. They gain a +1 Power bonus to attacks against this target.
The target suffers a -1 penalty to their agility. Can stack.
system.requirement: Target suffered an agility penalty due to Petrifying Gaze.

system.description:
You summon a 10ft high frosty tower within range. The tower has 45 HP, 4 guard and no reactions. Attacks against the tower always hit.

The tower acts at initiative 0, at the end of a round. When it does, it makes a single light attack using the your stats at every enemy within 20ft of it. This attack has half pierce, deals Frost damage and on damage, the enemy is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

You may create any weapon and use it immediately. You are considered proficient in any weapon created through this ability. These weapons may deal Frost damage instead of their normal damage. You may also create two weapons at the same time, but they must be two Light weapons of the same type. You may dismiss these weapons at any time for no cost.
Your initiative increases by 5. You may summon 1 tower described in ‘Frost Creation: Tower’ anywhere within range.

The target becomes temporarily petrified until the end of the encounter.

 

A petrified creature has 0 AP and RP and can take no actions, but gains a guard bonus of +10.

 

If the basilisk is not defeated at the encounter conclusion phase, the petrification becomes permanent.
You cannot use basic defensive actions: Block or Dodge, but you have 100 Damage Reduction to all non-magical attacks.
You attempt to bite a target creature making a Heavy attack against them. You heal for the damage this attack deals.

Numerous sparkling arcane crystals swarm the area and block line of sight.  Targets inside of or within 5ft of the Glittershards can only see up to 5ft into or out of Glittershards.  Glittershards lasts for up to 10 minutes and you can only have 1 Glittershards active at a time.  You can end this effect for 0 AP on your turn.

You attempt to consume a target, making a Heavy Attack against the target.  On hit, the target is affected by Gluttony and becomes engulfed in slime.  An engulfed target becomes Weakened.  An ally can attempt to pull a consumed target from the slime with a DC20 Power Check, removing the effects of Gluttony.
You make a Heavy Attack against the target.
You heal yourself for 15+Toughness HP
You deal 2 true damage to the target.

You lower your head as you charge and look to crash into either the target or an obstacle barring your path. Any object that is not made of sufficiently thick metal or stone (DM Discretion) is destroyed in the charge. Any creature behind said object is immediately knocked Prone and takes Light damage.

If this attack hits a creature, you will make a Heavy attack on the target. When using more than 2 AP on this movement, you gain an additional 1 focus and 2 power on this attack. On damage if the creature has less toughness than you, they are immediately knocked Prone and Dazed.

You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you and the target are both Rooted.

The target may spend 1 AP to break free, after which the target and you are both no longer rooted. If the target is grabbed by multiple enemies through this ability, spending the 1 AP will free it from all grabs.
You make a Heavy attack against all enemies within range.
You pull every enemy within range up to 40ft.
All enemies within 40ft of you are slowed. This applies immediately when they enter this range and lasts for the entire movement of leaving this range.
If you did not move in your last turn, your AP recovery and maximum AP increase by 1 (up to a maximum of 1).
You have 10ft reach, but your weapon is otherwise treated as a Light axe.

You bless the ground in a 10ft radius around yourself. Allies in the blessed ground regain HP equal to their Toughness when they spend an RP. The blessed ground remains set in place, even when you move.
You have +1 guard and +4 Block, but -2 Evasion (already added to stats). You also have 5 DR against slashing attacks.
You gain +1 Guard, and a further +2 Guard when taking the Block action (Already added to stats).
Your guard is increased by 2.
Each head that grows extra past the original 3 lowers your agility by 1 and movement speed by 5ft. When your agility reaches 0 because of this, you die.
When making a basic Light or Heavy Attack, you may attack with either your head or tail. You gain a benefit based on the body part chosen.

When a head is killed, two new heads immediately sprout from the defeated heads. These new heads share the element of the original defeated heads and function as two fresh heads as described in the multi-headed ability.
On dealing damage with a melee attack, you can follow-up with a headbutt as a Light attack. On damage the target is Unbalanced.
system.requirement: Landing a normal Light or Heavy attack

system.description: All creatures within range must make a save or take Light Fire damage.

You have a mount that has 25 HP and uses your defensive stats in combat. It follows the normal horse mount rules. While mounted, you can only move in a straight line while taking a movement action. After losing your mount, your movement speed is reduced to 20ft.
When you deal damage to a target, they become Unbalanced. If they are already Unbalanced, they become Dazed.
You gain a +1 bonus to your accuracy rolls (max +6) for each other Astran Magpie attacking the same target this round.
Holy damage dealt to you is treated as Full Pierce damage.
You take double damage from Holy damage.
You make a heavy attack against the target  with a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon.
system.range: Ranged Weapon Range or Thrown Weapon Range

system.description: When you become the target of an attack, the creature you are burrowed in takes the damage as well, even if you dodge the attack. Any damage you take is reduced by your host’s Guard against the attack. If the host takes damage from an area attack, you are also automatically hit.

You can passively hover up to 5ft above the ground. While hovering, you are not an eligible target for abilities that require a target to be flying or airborne unless you'd meet those conditions normally.

You breathe in a 30ft cone, making a Light attack against all targets in it. The damage type is based on the head’s element. On damage, you apply an effect based on the head’s element. The Earth head inflicts Daze for 1 turn, the Frost head inflicts Slowed for 1 turn and the Lightning head inflicts Static X for 1 turn, where X is your Power x 3.
You and the target both become rooted. The target may spend 2 AP to break free, after which the target and you are both no longer rooted.

Each head has an element. There is an Earth, a Frost, and a Lightning element head. Each head takes half damage from attacks dealing the same type of damage as their element. Their element also influences their Hydra Breath attack.
You provoke no attacks of opportunity from Slowed enemies. You gain a +4 bonus to Guard when taking the Block reaction. (Already added to stats)
You take no damage from Frost damage.
You take half damage from Frost damage.
When killed, the spot you were killed on turns into ice and becomes difficult terrain for other creatures.

You make a Heavy attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes rooted until the start of your next turn.

Combo: If used after Black Knight’s Charge, this ability’s cost is reduced to 1 AP and the attack gains Full Pierce.
You do not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target.
You do not spend your RP when reacting against a physical attack made with a non-magical weapon. A weapon that is enchanted counts as magical.
You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target.
system.requirement: You and the target must both be standing on Ink.

system.description: When you die, you explode in a blob of ink. You Blind all enemies and create difficult terrain in a 5ft radius around you.
You take the Dodge action against the triggering attack, then teleport up to 40ft.
system.requirement: You are the target of an attack.

system.description: You can use Gluttony as an attack of opportunity for 1 RP.
You make a Light attack against the target that deals Physical(Piercing) damage.
You have +2 guard and +6 Block (already added to stats).

You move one of your Swarms up to 20ft or you may Sidestep an ally up to 20ft.

You may also spend 1 RP to use this ability instead.

You summon a swarm of insects in a 15x15 square. Any creature except for you, a devouring swarm or a summoner contracted to you ending their turn inside of it takes Full Pierce Light damage.

You may have up to two of these swarms active at the same time.
You leap out from below that ground and make a Heavy attack against the target.

The dreameater only attacks sleeping targets and a battle against the dream eater does not take place in the physical world, but in a dreamscape created by it. A creature that is ‘killed’ by the dreameater does not die. Instead, they do not gain the normal benefits of resting and their mana is reduced by 2. If their mana would go below 0 because of this, they instead lose 5 Max HP per mana that could not be reduced. This effect lasts until the creature completes a rest undisturbed by the dreameater or until the dreameater dies.
You land a critical hit when you roll 18 or higher.
You do not lose altitude for being hit while flying. However, you count as mounted for anti-mount abilities such as Brace.
When your HP is lowered to 0, you will immediately use Explode Self as a reaction. After that, you immediately die.

You always act right before other wolves do. Their initiative is placed as 0.1 higher than that of normal wolves. When you are alive at the encounter start phase, wolves act first in the case of a tied initiative.
All Grunt level allies under your command gain a +1 bonus to their Focus and Agility.
You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, all allied Wolves may move up to their movement speed closer to the target.
You jump to a target within range and make a Light attack against it.
You heal for Toughness HP at the start of your turn.
This creature has 40 block, but cannot dodge.
If you are in an area with a bright light, become Weakened.

You turn into a ball of lightning and Sidestep in a straight line to a square within range. You can pass through units while doing so and may make a Light attack against each unit you pass through. This attack deals Lightning damage.
You take no damage from Lightning damage.

While in a dreamspace created by a dreameater, all abilities that have restrictions such as “Can only be used once per X.” or “You regain the use of this ability after a rest.” cannot be used. The exception to this is abilities that say “Can only be used once per encounter.” or “You regain the use of this ability at the Encounter Conclusion Phase”.
You may fly during your movement at your normal speed, but if you are still airborne at the end of your turn, you fall to the ground taking fall damage as normal.
All enemies within range must make a Save or become Unbalanced. They also become Slowed until the end of your next turn.
You gain a +1 bonus to your accuracy rolls (max +3) for each other Astran Magpie attacking the same target this round. All Astran Magpie's take their turn at the same time.
When an ally within 60ft rolls a 1, they may automatically reroll that roll and accept the new result.
The target must reroll their roll. Can not be used on a roll that was already rerolled.

You may Sidestep 5ft and the attack against you automatically misses.

Roll a d20. If you roll 11 or higher, you recover 2 RP.
system.requirement: You are the target of an attack.

system.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If the attack hits, it is automatically a critical hit.
You shoot a golden coin at an enemy, making a Light attack against the target that deals 2d10 Astra damage, but doesn’t receive bonuses from power.

Any creature within range that’s more than 10ft away from the you must make a save. If they fail, they must spend AP on their next turn to move as close to you as possible. Once they are within 5ft of you, the effect ends.
Your melee attacks gain an additional 60ft range. They are still counted as melee attacks and do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
You makes a Heavy attack against the target that deals maximum Heavy damage. This attack automatically misses if the target uses the Dodge reaction.
You heal for Toughness x 3 HP at the start of your turn.
You are immune to all mind-affecting effects.
You gain +1 Guard.
You make a Light attack that deals Arcane damage to all enemies within range.

When your HP reaches 0 or lower, all Grunt level allies under your command experience Morale Failure. Unless there is another Heroic level ally on the battlefield, all Grunt level allies will attempt to flee the battlefield, potentially instantly ending the encounter.

You may move up to twice your movement in a straight line towards a target further than 20ft away and gain Trample after moving at least 20ft. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against them. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

When you reach the target you make a Heavy attack against them

You have 3 heads, each with their own HP and element. Each head has 2 AP, 3 RP and they all use the same stats as listed in the stats block. Roll separate initiative for each head. An AoE attack only does damage to one of the heads, chosen by the attacker.

You trap the target in a magical cage and teleport them next to you. The target becomes Stunned.

The cage can be targeted by attacks. Attacks against it cannot miss, it has 55 HP, no reactions and has a base guard of 0. When its HP reaches 0 or if your HP reaches 0, the cage is destroyed.

When the cage is destroyed, the trapped target may immediately take a turn after the current creature’s turn has ended, regardless of their initiative. They do double damage during this turn. Their initiative does not change based on this immediate turn.
You may use Burrow as an opportunity attack for 0 RP.

All enemies must make a save against your potency (10+Focus) or become stricken with irrational fear. While feared, all their attacks targeting you cost +1 AP and you gain +4 to hit against them.

  • You gain Tremorsense in your hive area, becoming aware of the exact location of all creatures touching the ground.

  • When an enemy dies while in the domain, you may choose to spawn an Ixith swarm in that location without paying the normal cost as a swarm bursts from the corpse. These do not count against your normal limits. In addition, when an enemy dies in your domain you heal for your Toughness x2

You cover a 30x30ft square surface in webs. All creatures in the webbed area become slowed. The webs last until this ability is used again, or until the webs take fire damage on which they are immediately destroyed. Any creature touching the webbing when it is lit on fire becomes Burning 10.

 

Any creature that ends their turn in the webbed area becomes rooted. This lasts until they or an ally spends 4 AP to free themselves. After a unit is freed from the webs, they cannot become rooted by the same web until the end of their next turn. If the webbing is destroyed, a rooted creature is also immediately freed.
